briefdescription.para: Lightweight, non-owning tensor description used by ONNX graph optimisation passes.

detaileddescription.para: The onnx_optim namespace exposes three small value types:

listitem.para: :cpp:class:OptimDim — a single shape dimension, either a concrete int64_t or a symbolic string expression.

:cpp:class:OptimTensor — a non-owning view over a contiguous buffer carrying a :cpp:type:TensorType, an :cpp:class:OptimShape, and an optional shape annotation when the tensor itself represents a shape (e.g. the shape input of Reshape).

detaileddescription.para: These types are intentionally header-only friendly and never allocate the tensor data they describe; callers are responsible for the lifetime of the underlying buffer.
